dct:title: Logical Definition Import — Infectious Diseases
dct:description: Adds 152 logical definitions (EquivalentClasses axioms) to Foundation infectious disease entities that currently lack them. Each definition derives from a Mondo EquivalentClasses axiom (no constructed definitions). Filler classes reference ICD extension code entities by WHO-FIC Foundation entity IRI (descendants of http://id.who.int/icd/entity/1920852714). Definitions whose fillers require proposed new extension codes are deferred until batch 2026-Q3-extcode-infectious-01 is approved.

icd:scope.icd:constraint: Foundation entities with SSSOM exact Mondo match (confidence >= 0.9) that LACK an existing icd:logicalDefinition

icd:translationRules.description: Mondo logical definitions use RO relations; these are translated to ICD axis vocabulary using the axis alignment from 2026-Q2-axis-align-01. Filler classes are translated from external ontologies to ICD-11 extension codes using the filler mapping table.
icd:translationRules.fillerTranslation: NCBITaxon organisms and UBERON anatomy terms are mapped to WHO-FIC Foundation extension code entities (descendants of http://id.who.int/icd/entity/1920852714) using rdfs:label and entity IRIs from whofic-2025-05-24-labeled.owl. Mappings documented in filler_to_icd11_extension_code_map.tsv.
icd:translationRules.genus_translation: Mondo genus classes are mapped to their Foundation equivalents (same SSSOM mapping set); if no Foundation equivalent exists, the logical definition is excluded

icd:upstream.icd:reason: Axis alignment axioms required so ELK can verify Mondo-equivalence of translated definitions
9 deferred logical definitions require proposed new extension codes from this batch
icd:upstream.icd:note: 143 ready definitions can proceed independently; 9 are blocked until new extension codes are approved

icd:downstream: Classification-based QC for subtree import batch (uses logical definitions for equivalence verification)

icd:exclusionCriteria: Foundation entity already has a logical definition (avoid conflict)
Mondo LogDef uses non-EL constructs (ObjectUnionOf, negation)
Foundation-Mondo mapping scope mismatch (e.g., Foundation 'viral hepatitis' maps to Mondo 'hepatitis B')
Differentia filler has no Foundation equivalent (unmapped anatomy or organism)
Mondo LogDef defines by non-biological criterion (setting, transmission mode)
Genus class has no Foundation equivalent
Mondo class lacks an EquivalentClasses axiom (no constructed definitions permitted)
